```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const moveAllSessionsMenu = () => {
    const menu = document.querySelector(".all-sessions-menu");
    const contents = document.querySelector("#TOC");

    if (!menu) return;
    if (contents) contents.appendChild(menu);
    menu.classList.add("all-sessions-menu-ready");
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", moveAllSessionsMenu);
  } else {
    moveAllSessionsMenu();
  }
})();
</script>
```
